from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class FixedStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)

        self.spy_last_close = None
        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma = None

        self.aapl_last_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
            previous_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None

            self.spy_previous_close = self.spy_last_close
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
            self.spy_previous_sma = previous_sma
            self.spy_last_close = spy_bar.Close

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

            if self.aapl_last_close is not None and aapl_bar.Close < self.aapl_last_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)
            self.aapl_last_close = aapl_bar.Close

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if (not self.spy_sma.IsReady or
                not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady or
                self.spy_previous_close is None or
                self.spy_previous_sma is None):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        spy_crosses_above_sma = (
            self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma and
            spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

        spy_crosses_below_sma = (
            self.spy_previous_close >= self.spy_previous_sma and
            spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

        # Slot 1: Strategy A
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity != 0 and spy_crosses_below_sma:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy)
        elif self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity == 0 and spy_crosses_above_sma:
            self.SetHoldings(self.spy, 0.40)

        # Slot 2: Strategy B
        if self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity != 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.Liquidate(self.aapl)
        elif self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            available_cash = self.Portfolio.CashBook[self.AccountCurrency].Amount

            if available_cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = math.floor(20_000 / float(aapl_close))

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)

from AlgorithmImports import *


class ParallelStrategiesAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        has_spy = data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy)
        has_aapl = data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl)

        current_red_streak = self.aapl_red_streak
        if has_aapl:
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                current_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                current_red_streak += 1
            else:
                current_red_streak = 0

        all_bars_present = all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols)

        if (
            all_bars_present
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
        ):
            spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            spy_sma_value = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

            spy_crosses_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > spy_sma_value
            )
            spy_crosses_below = (
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < spy_sma_value
            )

            if not self.Portfolio[self.spy].Invested and spy_crosses_above:
                self.SetHoldings(self.spy, 0.40)
            elif self.Portfolio[self.spy].Invested and spy_crosses_below:
                self.Liquidate(self.spy)

            if not self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Invested and current_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                    quantity = int(20_000 / float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close))
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
            elif (
                self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Invested
                and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
            ):
                self.Liquidate(self.aapl)

        if has_spy:
            self.previous_spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = (
                self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
            )

        if has_aapl:
            self.previous_aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
            self.aapl_red_streak = current_red_streak
